prompt: We ___ (move) to Valencia in June; we signed the contract last week.
explanation: El plan estaba decidido antes de hablar, así que toca going to y no will.

prompt: Look at those clouds! It ___ (rain) in a minute.
explanation: Hay una prueba delante (las nubes): predicción con going to.

prompt: I ___ (not / buy) that car; I decided yesterday.
___ (you / book) the tickets tonight, as we planned?
explanation: as we planned señala un plan ya cerrado: be delante del sujeto + going to.

prompt: She ___ (go) to the dentist tomorrow; she made the appointment last week.
explanation: going to go es correcto: going to es la estructura y go, el verbo.

prompt: They ___ (not / sell) the house this year; they changed their plans in January.
I have the recipe and the ingredients: I ___ (cook) a paella on Sunday.
He is going to study Italian next summer.
solution: He is not going to study Italian next summer.
explanation: El not va detrás del verbo be: is not going to study.

prompt: They are going to visit their cousins next weekend.
solution: Are they going to visit their cousins next weekend?
explanation: El verbo be pasa delante del sujeto y going to no se toca.

prompt: We are going to paint the kitchen this weekend; we bought the paint yesterday.
explanation: La pintura ya está comprada: el plan viene de antes, así que going to.

prompt: Careful! You are going to drop those glasses.
explanation: Predicción con la prueba delante de los ojos: going to, no will.

prompt: The goalkeeper has the ball under control; the other team is not going to score this time.
explanation: La situación visible permite una predicción negativa con be going to.
